zh: 相似只看出现了哪些字母，而字母只有26个，所以每个字母集合都能压缩成一个26位的二进制数；两个字符串相似当且仅当这个数相等。
用哈希表统计每个掩码已经出现过多少次；处理到一个字符串时，它能和之前所有掩码相同的字符串各组成一对。
逐行读取（空行表示空串，掩码为0），对每个字符把对应位设为1；先把哈希表中该掩码已有的次数加入答案，再把次数加1。答案可能约5×10^9，需要64位整数。
en: Similarity only depends on which letters appear, and there are just 26 letters, so each letter set compresses into a 26-bit number; two strings are similar exactly when these numbers are equal.
Use a hash map to count how many times each mask has appeared so far; when a string is processed, it forms a pair with every earlier string that has the same mask.

Read line by line (an empty line is an empty string with mask 0) and set the bit of each character; first add the count already stored for this mask to the answer, then increase that count by 1. The answer can be about 5×10^9, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Represent each letter set as a 26-bit mask, and for each string add the number of earlier strings with the same mask.

## Proof of correctness

Each bit records exactly whether its letter occurs, so two masks are equal if and only if the sets are the same; each index pair is counted once, when the later of the two strings is scanned.

## Complexity

Time O(total length + n), space O(n).
